title: memoryreplay
description: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) dataset from a study of episodic memory retrieval, in which participants recalled episodes while neural activity was recorded. The data support analyses of rapid neural replay of episode content during successful retrieval. The dataset includes a memory phase and a localizer phase, with trigger channels marking stimulus categories and answer onsets.
methods_description: MEG was recorded with a trigger channel marking event timing. Visual onset lagged the trigger by about 20 ms, as estimated with a photodiode. In the memory phase, each trial began with a trigger for the image category (1-8), and the answer onset was marked by trigger 11 about 5.5 s later. The localizer phase used the same category triggers, with a word naming each picture shown for 2 s before picture onset. Sequenceness was computed as the Frobenius inner product between the lag-wise regression matrix and a 6 x 6 transition matrix, z-scored across lags, and differential forward-backward sequenceness was then derived.
